description: This PHP class defines a data model for employee attachments within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin API. It serializes and normalizes `PartialEmployeeAttachment` entities for API interactions, including schema annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentModel
classes.description: Represents a serializable API model for employee attachment data, facilitating normalization and attribute filtering for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a PartialEmployeeAttachment entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings.
